newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: First black woman to head S.African province.
newsitem.headline: First black woman to head S.African province.

text.p: The former chairwoman of South Africa's state broadcasting service was elected as premier of Free State province on Wednesday, the first woman to head one of the country's nine regions, state radio reported.
Ivy Matsepe-Casaburri, former chairwoman of the South African Broadcasting Corporation and a member of President Nelson Mandela's ruling African National Congress (ANC), replaces Patrick Lekota.
She was elected by a vote of 24 to 4 in the executive committee of the provincial legislature.
Mandela removed the popular Lekota as premier last month to end a personality feud between members of the executive committee.
